title: Locker and Recipe
author: Mara Delacroix
blurb: Ines Lockridge, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must save the tradition that made the town before graduation.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
